advisory_items.escalation_condition: If the owner treats 'every declared fail_closed_code must be reachable with exit 3 for its declared input class' as a hard acceptance gate, escalate this item to BLOCKING; only this one-line fix then needs re-review.
advisory_items.evidence: Live probes --case /dev/stdin with top-level JSON [1,2,3], "hello", 42, true, null all raise uncaught AttributeError ('list'/'str'/'int'/'bool'/'NoneType' object has no attribute 'get'), exit code 1, no result record written. Root cause: evaluate_bundle()'s except FailClosed handler guards bundle.get at line 386 with isinstance(bundle, dict) but line 397 'expected_category_for_qualification_only': bundle.get('expected_category', 'UNRESOLVED') has no guard. The decision logic itself is correct - line 321-322 raises FailClosed('FC_INPUT_NOT_JSON_OBJECT') properly - the error-reporting path is what crashes. evaluator_spec.json declares FC_INPUT_NOT_JSON_OBJECT and decision_rule.fail_closed promises REVIEW_REQUIRED + NOT_EVALUATED + fail_closed_code + exit 3 for invalid input; README documents exit 3.
advisory_items.impact: Declared-contract violation on one input class. Failure mode is loud (exit 1 + traceback), produces no wrong verdict and no silent pass; run_qualification.py scores it as INVALID_OUTPUT and a mismatch, so it cannot inflate a qualification score or leak a defect. The 34-case qualification set is unaffected.
advisory_items.recommendation: Add an isinstance(bundle, dict) guard at line 397 (or normalize at evaluate_bundle entry), and add one fixture with a non-object JSON top level to pin FC_INPUT_NOT_JSON_OBJECT.
advisory_items.title: Non-object JSON case bundles crash (exit 1) instead of fail-closing with FC_INPUT_NOT_JSON_OBJECT and exit 3
advisory_items.why_not_blocking: None of acceptance assertions A1/A2/A3 or A-common is violated: A2's three named conditions (missing field / wrong binding / empty set) all fail closed explicitly with exit 3; the crash cannot produce ALLOW, BLOCK or a pass; the artifact is undeployed and unenabled.

dissent.internal: The runner-up disposition was PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW, on the grounds that A1 is a genuine spec-versus-implementation mismatch on a declared fail_closed_code, and that in an artifact whose central value proposition is fail-closed integrity an incomplete fail-closed net is materially more serious than a cosmetic defect. I chose ACCEPTED instead because (a) the failure mode is loud rather than silent - exit 1 with a traceback and no result record, which run_qualification.py scores as INVALID_OUTPUT and a mismatch, so it cannot be used to game a score or leak a defect; (b) it touches none of the three acceptance assertions, whose named conditions were all independently verified; (c) the 34-case qualification evidence is unaffected; and (d) the fix is a single defensive guard whose correctness is locally verifiable. I want the escalation condition stated in the blocking_items field of this proposal preserved verbatim: if the owner treats complete implementation of every declared fail_closed_code for its declared input class as a hard acceptance gate - a defensible reading of A2 - then this decision should be revisited as BLOCKING and only that one-line fix re-reviewed. The alternative runner-up was REJECTED on the grounds that an evaluation base with a hole in its fail-closed net should not be accepted at all; I rejected that because it would equate a loud, non-gameable edge-path crash with a defect that threatens the verdict, which the evidence does not support.
dissent.recorded_for: closeout authority (registry/state owner) and any subsequent human adjudication

justification: All three card acceptance assertions and A-common were independently recomputed and hold. (1) A1: the three degenerate strategies were re-derived from the frozen expected distribution (15 defects / 8 legal / 11 review = 34) against the simultaneous 'defect detection AND legal non-interception' gate - ALL_BLOCK, ALL_ALLOW and ALL_REVIEW_REQUIRED each fail it, matching reliability_spec 6.4 which states that sending everything to review is also not success. (2) A2: missing-field, wrong-binding and empty-set each have an explicit fixture failing closed with exit 3, and axis separation is enforced (direction C rejected, no cross-axis aggregate). (3) A3: the evaluator reads candidate artifact bytes only to hash them (verified in verify_hash), a candidate self-authored 'SELF_AUTHORED_PASS_LABEL' is rejected as an unknown signature, untrusted provenance is rejected as an ownership violation, and sealed access is correctly presented as PROPOSAL_ONLY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED with PT-01..PT-06 specified and explicitly unexecuted and no sealed-qualification claim. Cross-cutting integrity: the 51-entry manifest recomputes 51/51 with zero hash or byte mismatches; all 10 input_bindings match under two independent methods (byte-derived git blob SHA-1 and an independent parse of .git/index) plus sha256_file; the protocol freeze value matches at protocol.json:107; two fresh live qualification runs both return 34/34 with exit 0; the recorded 68 pass entries are internally consistent with recomputed family coverage and expected distribution; the T1 v3 assertion adapter - the surface this review was specifically directed to audit - is faithful on all 16 cases across incident_id, expected_category, failure_family, artifact_level and control_class, with assertion semantics matching the source observed facts; the nested source_ref drift disclosure is exactly accurate (2 of 33 refs, precisely the two named); the issues_found_and_fixed ledger is corroborated by events.jsonl including the 26/34 to 34/34 arithmetic (8 legal controls); and no forged ACCEPTED, freeze, PROMOTED or SCIENTIFIC_PASS claim exists anywhere in the package. Counter-evidence sweeps found no hidden all-block/all-allow/all-review bias (actual distribution 8/15/11) and no answer leakage (flipping expected_category leaves the decision unchanged). The single substantive defect (A1) is a one-line missing guard in the fail-closed error-reporting path for a non-object JSON top level; it fails loudly, cannot produce a wrong verdict or a silent pass, cannot inflate a qualification score, and violates none of the acceptance assertions, so it is recorded as the top advisory with an explicit escalation condition rather than blocking. This matches the established convention in which T1I-03 accepted a comparable engineering artifact with documented advisories. The verdict is engineering-qualification only: it grants no formal experiment authority, no scientific PASS, no sealed-access qualification, no promotion and no deployment.
